gloss: to become stiff; to be absorbed in

definitions.explanation: used for muscles that have tensed up due to fatigue or strain

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in; to be obsessed with; to be elaborate
definitions.explanation: to put great effort into something, often to an excessive degree

notes:
SENSE 1 - MUSCLE STIFFNESS:
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{凝|こ}る (stiff shoulders) - very common expression
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{凝|こ}る (stiff neck)
- Common in Japan due to long work hours

SENSE 2 - BEING ABSORBED:
- ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{凝|こ}る / ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{凝|こ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (to be into something)
- {凝|こ}った + noun = elaborate, intricate
- ⟦{凝|こ}り{性|しょう}→凝り性：15009_korishou⟧ (obsessive personality)

TRANSITIVITY:
